title: Harmful Content Generation in Text-to-Image Models: Capabilities and Moderation Limitations

bias_targets.methodology: Automated prompt transformation using an LLM to rewrite neutral news captions into visual descriptions that deliberately use exaggerated, offensive, or culturally damaging stereotypes about groups of people, followed by human evaluation and moderation API scoring of the generated images.

Using an LLM to convert benign captions into provocative prompts that explicitly promote hostility, hate group iconography, or racist/anti-Semitic tropes against specific groups, assessed via human annotation for graphicness/intent and detection rates by automated moderation systems.
